schema.text: How does the quality of signs and wayfinding on your route affect your confidence as a pedestrian?

options.text: I never look at signs; their quality has no effect on my navigation
I find signs helpful if I need them but I rarely feel lost
I rely on signs to confirm I am on the right track or to find exits and crossings
I often have to stop and double-check my position because signs are unclear or missing
Signs are so poor that I cannot navigate without using a GPS or phone app

en.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: How does the quality of signs and wayfinding on your route affect your confidence as a pedestrian?
en.#I never look at signs; their quality ha: I never look at signs; their quality has no effect on my navigation
en.#I find signs helpful if I need them but: I find signs helpful if I need them but I rarely feel lost
en.#I rely on signs to confirm I am on the: I rely on signs to confirm I am on the right track or to find exits and crossings
en.#I often have to stop and double-check m: I often have to stop and double-check my position because signs are unclear or missing
en.#Signs are so poor that I cannot navigat: Signs are so poor that I cannot navigate without using a GPS or phone app

it.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: In che modo la qualità della segnaletica e delle indicazioni lungo il percorso influisce sulla tua sicurezza nell'orientarti come pedone?
it.#I never look at signs; their quality ha: Non guardo mai i segnali; la loro qualità non influisce sul mio orientamento
it.#I find signs helpful if I need them but: Trovo utili i segnali quando ne ho bisogno, ma raramente mi sento disorientato/a
it.#I rely on signs to confirm I am on the: Faccio affidamento sui segnali per confermare di essere sul percorso giusto o per trovare uscite e attraversamenti
it.#I often have to stop and double-check m: Spesso devo fermarmi e ricontrollare la mia posizione perché i segnali sono poco chiari o mancanti
it.#Signs are so poor that I cannot navigat: La segnaletica è così carente che non riesco a orientarmi senza utilizzare un GPS o un'app sul telefono

fr.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Comment la qualité des panneaux et des indications d’orientation sur votre trajet influence-t-elle votre confiance lorsque vous marchez ?
fr.#I never look at signs; their quality ha: Je ne regarde jamais les panneaux ; leur qualité n’a aucun effet sur mon orientation
fr.#I find signs helpful if I need them but: Les panneaux sont utiles quand j’en ai besoin, mais je me perds rarement
fr.#I rely on signs to confirm I am on the: J’utilise les panneaux pour vérifier que je suis sur le bon chemin ou pour trouver les sorties et les traversées
fr.#I often have to stop and double-check m: Je dois souvent m’arrêter et vérifier ma position parce que les panneaux sont peu clairs ou absents
fr.#Signs are so poor that I cannot navigat: La signalisation est si mauvaise que je ne peux pas m’orienter sans GPS ou application sur téléphone

de.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Wie beeinflussen Qualität und Verständlichkeit von Schildern und Wegweisung Ihr Vertrauen beim Gehen?
de.#I never look at signs; their quality ha: Ich schaue nie auf Schilder; ihre Qualität beeinflusst meine Orientierung nicht
de.#I find signs helpful if I need them but: Schilder sind hilfreich, wenn ich sie brauche, aber ich verlaufe mich selten
de.#I rely on signs to confirm I am on the: Ich nutze Schilder, um zu prüfen, ob ich richtig bin, oder um Ausgänge und Querungen zu finden
de.#I often have to stop and double-check m: Ich muss oft anhalten und meine Position prüfen, weil Schilder unklar sind oder fehlen
de.#Signs are so poor that I cannot navigat: Die Beschilderung ist so schlecht, dass ich mich ohne GPS oder Handy-App nicht orientieren kann

tr.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Güzergâhınızdaki tabela ve yönlendirmelerin kalitesi yaya olarak kendinize güveninizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#I never look at signs; their quality ha: Tabelalara hiç bakmam; kaliteleri yönümü bulmamı etkilemez
tr.#I find signs helpful if I need them but: İhtiyaç duyduğumda tabelaları yararlı bulurum ama nadiren kaybolurum
tr.#I rely on signs to confirm I am on the: Doğru yolda olduğumu kontrol etmek veya çıkış ve geçitleri bulmak için tabelalara güvenirim
tr.#I often have to stop and double-check m: Tabelalar belirsiz veya eksik olduğu için sık sık durup konumumu kontrol etmek zorunda kalırım
tr.#Signs are so poor that I cannot navigat: Tabelalar o kadar yetersiz ki GPS veya telefon uygulaması olmadan yönümü bulamam

fa.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: کیفیت تابلوها و راهنمای مسیر چگونه بر اطمینان شما هنگام پیاده‌روی اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#I never look at signs; their quality ha: اصلاً به تابلوها نگاه نمی‌کنم؛ کیفیت آن‌ها بر جهت‌یابی من اثری ندارد
fa.#I find signs helpful if I need them but: اگر لازم باشد تابلوها برایم مفیدند، اما به ندرت مسیر را گم می‌کنم
fa.#I rely on signs to confirm I am on the: برای مطمئن شدن از مسیر درست یا پیدا کردن خروجی و محل عبور به تابلوها تکیه می‌کنم
fa.#I often have to stop and double-check m: چون تابلوها نامشخص یا ناقص‌اند، اغلب باید بایستم و موقعیتم را دوباره بررسی کنم
fa.#Signs are so poor that I cannot navigat: تابلوها آن‌قدر نامناسب‌اند که بدون GPS یا برنامه تلفن نمی‌توانم مسیر را پیدا کنم

hu.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: Hogyan befolyásolja az útvonalán található táblák és útbaigazítások minősége a magabiztosságát gyaloglás közben?
hu.#I never look at signs; their quality ha: Soha nem nézem a táblákat; a minőségük nem befolyásolja a tájékozódásomat
hu.#I find signs helpful if I need them but: Hasznosnak találom a táblákat, ha szükségem van rájuk, de ritkán tévedek el
hu.#I rely on signs to confirm I am on the: A táblákat használom annak ellenőrzésére, hogy jó irányban haladok-e, illetve kijáratok és átkelőhelyek megtalálására
hu.#I often have to stop and double-check m: Gyakran meg kell állnom és ellenőriznem a helyzetemet, mert a táblák nem egyértelműek vagy hiányoznak
hu.#Signs are so poor that I cannot navigat: A jelzések annyira rosszak, hogy GPS vagy telefonos alkalmazás nélkül nem tudok tájékozódni

ar.#How does the quality of signs and wayfi: كيف تؤثر جودة اللافتات وإرشادات الطريق على ثقتك أثناء المشي؟
ar.#I never look at signs; their quality ha: لا أنظر إلى اللافتات؛ جودتها لا تؤثر في قدرتي على معرفة الطريق
ar.#I find signs helpful if I need them but: أجد اللافتات مفيدة عند الحاجة لكنني نادرًا ما أضل الطريق
ar.#I rely on signs to confirm I am on the: أعتمد على اللافتات للتأكد من أنني على الطريق الصحيح أو للعثور على المخارج والمعابر
ar.#I often have to stop and double-check m: أضطر كثيرًا إلى التوقف والتأكد من موقعي لأن اللافتات غير واضحة أو مفقودة
ar.#Signs are so poor that I cannot navigat: اللافتات سيئة لدرجة أنني لا أستطيع معرفة الطريق من دون GPS أو تطبيق على الهاتف
